sounds.name: Unseen Footsteps 001
sounds.description: Soft footsteps pass by with nobody there, beneath a faint eerie tone.

sounds.name: Otherworld Wind 001
sounds.description: An otherworldly wind howls softly with two slightly detuned drones beating beneath it.

sounds.name: Impossible Geometry 001
sounds.description: Four chords step through shapes that should not exist, each a fifth above the last tone.

sounds.name: Shadow Stretch 001
sounds.description: A shadow stretches unnaturally with a sliding low drone and a faint creak.

sounds.name: Memory Fade 001
sounds.description: A memory fades away in four falling glides, each fainter than the last.

sounds.name: Superposition Flicker 001
sounds.description: Two tones flicker in a quantum superposition, switching rapidly over a steady hum.

sounds.name: Anomaly Detector 001
sounds.description: A detector clicks faster and faster as it nears a spatial anomaly.

sounds.name: Wrong Door Knock 001
sounds.description: Three knocks sound on a door, and then lower knocks answer from somewhere impossible.

sounds.name: Cosmic Whale Song 001
sounds.description: A vast cosmic creature sings slow, deep gliding calls that rise and then fall.

sounds.name: Spiral Descent 001
sounds.description: A spiral descent: fourteen stepped tones fall while a long glide plunges beneath them.

sounds.name: Hourglass Reverse 001
sounds.description: Sand flows upward in a reversed hourglass, swelling and ending in a chime.

sounds.name: Static Between Worlds 001
sounds.description: A radio hops between worlds: bursts of static, fragments of tones and then silence.

sounds.name: Unraveling Threads 001
sounds.description: Threads of reality unravel with quickening, rising ticks and a final low note.

sounds.name: Seed Pod Burst 001
sounds.description: Dry seed pod snaps open and flings its seeds, which patter on the ground.

sounds.name: Flower Bud Open 001
sounds.description: Soft petals unfurl as a flower bud slowly opens.

sounds.name: Dew Roll Drop 001
sounds.description: A dewdrop slides down a leaf blade and drops off with a small plop.

sounds.name: Ant Colony March 001
sounds.description: Hundreds of tiny feet tick in a steady column as an ant colony marches past.

sounds.name: Beetle Wing Unfold 001
sounds.description: A beetle pops its wing cases open, then its folded wings whir into flight.

sounds.name: Cocoon Crack 001
sounds.description: A papery cocoon splits from the inside with small crackles and a soft thump.

sounds.name: Spider Silk Pluck 001
sounds.description: A taut strand of spider silk is plucked and rings with a thin, high shimmer.

sounds.name: Caterpillar Chew 001
sounds.description: A caterpillar munches a leaf in five slow, juicy bites.

sounds.name: Leafcutter Snip 001
sounds.description: A leafcutter ant slices a leaf edge with crisp, tiny snips.

sounds.name: Firefly Pulse 001
sounds.description: A firefly glows twice, each pulse a soft rising shimmer.

sounds.name: Pollen Puff 001
sounds.description: A flower releases a soft puff of pollen dust.

sounds.name: Root Groan 001
sounds.description: A thick root slowly strains and creaks as it pushes through the soil.

sounds.name: Vine Whip Snap 001
sounds.description: A springy vine lashes through the air and snaps taut.

sounds.name: Mushroom Cap Pop 001
sounds.description: A soft, hollow pop as a mushroom cap bursts through the ground cover.

sounds.name: Spore Cloud Release 001
sounds.description: A fungus exhales a drifting cloud of spores, a hiss of fine granular grains.

sounds.name: Snail Slime Glide 001
sounds.description: A snail glides over a surface with a wet, slow squelching trail.

sounds.name: Grasshopper Leap 001
sounds.description: A grasshopper kicks off a stem, flutters a wing and lands in the grass.

sounds.name: Dragonfly Dart 001
sounds.description: A dragonfly darts forward and brakes into a hover.

sounds.name: Acorn Bounce 001
sounds.description: An acorn falls and bounces several times on bark, each bounce shorter than the last.

sounds.name: Thorn Scrape 001
sounds.description: A thorn drags across a rough surface in stuttering scratches.

sounds.name: Bark Beetle Gnaw 001
sounds.description: A bark beetle bores into wood with a fast, fine rasping gnaw.

sounds.name: Nectar Sip 001
sounds.description: A tiny insect sips nectar with a quick wet slurp and two small smacks.

sounds.name: Seedling Sprout 001
sounds.description: Soil cracks and a seedling pushes up, growing with a soft rising tone.

sounds.name: Glow Fungus Hum 001
sounds.description: A bioluminescent fungus hums with a slow, beating, eerie glow.

sounds.name: Flytrap Snap 001
sounds.description: A carnivorous plant lures with a soft hum, then snaps shut with a squish.

sounds.name: Glacier Moulin Gurgle 001
sounds.description: Meltwater swirls and gurgles down a deep shaft inside a glacier.

sounds.name: Iceberg Roll 001
sounds.description: A huge iceberg slowly rolls over, sloshing water and groaning under its own weight.

sounds.name: Icicle Snap 001
sounds.description: A thin icicle snaps off and tinkles into brittle pieces on the ground.

sounds.name: Ice Cave Whistle 001
sounds.description: Wind funnels through an ice cavern, producing an eerie hollow whistle.

sounds.name: Snow Slab Whump 001
sounds.description: A weak snow layer collapses with a dull whump and a hiss of settling snow.

sounds.name: Frost Crystal Glint 001
sounds.description: Delicate frost crystals form with a sparkle of tiny high glints.

sounds.name: Frost Heave Creak 001
sounds.description: Freezing ground heaves upward with dull cracks and slow, groaning creaks.

sounds.name: Scree Pebble Trickle 001
sounds.description: Loose pebbles trickle and bounce down a scree slope, slowly dying away.

sounds.name: Boulder Settle 001
sounds.description: A boulder shifts with a grinding scrape, thuds into place and lets pebbles settle.

sounds.name: Cliff Edge Crumble 001
sounds.description: The edge of a cliff crumbles away, with debris falling and thudding far below.

sounds.name: Cave Boom Echo 001
sounds.description: A deep boom reverberates through a cavern as four fading echoes.

sounds.name: Sinkhole Collapse 001
sounds.description: The ground cracks and gives way into a sinkhole, rubble falling to a final thud.

sounds.name: Geyser Eruption 001
sounds.description: A geyser builds with gurgles and a steam hiss, then erupts in a roaring water column.

sounds.name: Obsidian Flake Chip 001
sounds.description: Sharp flakes of volcanic glass chip off a core, each ringing briefly.

sounds.name: Cooling Rock Tick 001
sounds.description: Hot rock contracts as it cools, giving off sparse metallic ticks.

sounds.name: Geode Split Shimmer 001
sounds.description: A geode cracks open and its crystal interior shimmers with glassy overtones.

sounds.name: Hollow Rock Tap 001
sounds.description: Three taps on a rock reveal a hollow cavity behind it.

sounds.name: Singing Dune Boom 001
sounds.description: A sand dune slips and booms with a deep, humming resonance.

sounds.name: Drought Clay Crack 001
sounds.description: Dried clay splits into a web of small, dry cracks.

sounds.name: Salt Crust Crunch 001
sounds.description: Brittle salt crust crunches and shatters underfoot.

sounds.name: Plate Stick Slip 001
sounds.description: Deep rock plates strain and then slip in three sudden jerks.

sounds.name: Volcanic Ash Fall 001
sounds.description: Fine volcanic ash drifts down with a soft hiss and tiny grains pattering.

sounds.name: Magma Chamber Throb 001
sounds.description: A magma chamber pulses with slow, deep throbs under constant rumble.

sounds.name: Pumice Water Bump 001
sounds.description: Light pumice stones bump together as they float on water.

sounds.name: Ice Shelf Chirp 001
sounds.description: A fast descending chirp zips across an ice shelf and echoes away.

sounds.name: Autonomous Pod Glide 001
sounds.description: An autonomous transit pod glides past with a smooth electric hum and a soft wind of motion.

sounds.name: Maglev Station Arrive 001
sounds.description: A maglev train brakes into a station with a falling whine and two arrival chimes.

sounds.name: Drone Delivery Drop 001
sounds.description: A delivery drone hovers, releases its package with a click and the parcel lands with a soft thud.

sounds.name: Smart Streetlight Wake 001
sounds.description: A smart streetlight switches on with a relay click, a warm hum and a final tick.

sounds.name: Sensor Mesh Ping 001
sounds.description: A chain of city sensors pings one after another in a rising, echoing mesh.

sounds.name: EV Charge Start 001
sounds.description: An electric vehicle plugs in with a click, a rising hum and two confirmation beeps.

sounds.name: EV Charge Complete 001
sounds.description: A charger winds down and signals a full battery with two bright chimes.

sounds.name: Traffic AI Reroute 001
sounds.description: A traffic system scans for a new route with four quick blips and a confirming tone.

sounds.name: Smart Crossing Beacon 001
sounds.description: A smart pedestrian crossing ticks faster and higher as the time runs out, then ends on a long tone.

sounds.name: Recycling Sorter Whir 001
sounds.description: A recycling sorter whirs and clacks as it pushes items into the right bins.

sounds.name: Smart Bin Compact 001
sounds.description: A smart bin compacts its waste with a motor groan, crunching and a final thud.

sounds.name: Air Quality Alert 001
sounds.description: A gentle three-note descending tone warns of poor air quality.

sounds.name: Hologram Billboard Flicker 001
sounds.description: A holographic billboard flickers to life, buzzing and popping with electrical stutters.

sounds.name: Smart Glass Tint 001
sounds.description: Smart glass tints from clear to dark with a smooth electronic shift and a small click.

sounds.name: Elevator Pod Chime 001
sounds.description: A smart elevator pod glides with a low hum and arrives with two bell tones.

sounds.name: Parking Spot Guide 001
sounds.description: A parking guidance system beeps faster as you near the free spot and confirms with a long tone.

sounds.name: Pneumatic Tube Transit 001
sounds.description: A capsule rushes through a pneumatic tube and arrives with a quick pop.

sounds.name: Water Grid Valve Open 001
sounds.description: A smart valve in the water grid whirs open, clunks and releases a rush of water.

sounds.name: Ticket Gate Tap 001
sounds.description: A transit gate accepts a card tap with a beep, a servo swing and a clack.

sounds.name: Street Robot Sweeper 001
sounds.description: A street-cleaning robot trundles along, its motor droning and brushes scratching.

sounds.name: Emergency Priority Signal 001
sounds.description: An emergency vehicle sends a priority signal to the road network in two rising chirp triplets.

sounds.name: Solar Panel Track 001
sounds.description: A solar panel array tracks the sun with a slow stepper motor, ticking steadily.

sounds.name: Data Hub Hum 001
sounds.description: A city data hub hums with fan noise and the occasional blip of traffic.

sounds.name: Crowd Density Pulse 001
sounds.description: A crowd-monitoring scan sweeps upward, each pulse marking a busy zone.

sounds.name: Skybridge Conveyor Glide 001
sounds.description: A moving walkway on a skybridge glides along with a low hum and the soft rhythm of its belt.
